summary: Drew and committed flat botanical-ink SVG illustrations for the six new UPDATE-1 cards (emergent-plant, free-floating-plant, diatoms, cyanobacteria, carbon-bacteria, nitrifying-bacteria) in public/art/ matching the existing set's viewBox (0 0 160 120), palette, stroke weights, and file size range (1.2-2.5 KB). Validated all six SVGs as well-formed XML and verified typecheck, test suite (59 passed), and production build.

done.what: Created public/art/emergent-plant.svg, public/art/free-floating-plant.svg, public/art/diatoms.svg, public/art/cyanobacteria.svg, public/art/carbon-bacteria.svg, and public/art/nitrifying-bacteria.svg matching src/ui/DESIGN.md and existing producer/microbe art style

evidence.test: PowerShell [xml] parse & viewBox/size check on all 6 SVG files
evidence.result: passed (all 6 parse as valid XML with viewBox='0 0 160 120', sizes 1230-2452 bytes)

evidence.test: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
evidence.result: passed (5 test files, 59 tests passed; vite build succeeded)

decisions.text: Used the microscope droplet medallion backdrop for diatoms.svg and cyanobacteria.svg (matching green-algae.svg and diatom.svg), the split air/water column backdrop for emergent-plant.svg and free-floating-plant.svg (matching aquatic-plant.svg and river-grass.svg), and the spore-rose dashed medallion with nutrient shape emblems for carbon-bacteria.svg and nitrifying-bacteria.svg (matching nitrogen-bacteria.svg and phosphorus-bacteria.svg).
